registered: 2026-11-25, before any MFeval output was seen
reference_tool: MFeval (Marco Furlan, MathWorks File Exchange 63618); run by the user in MATLAB with benchmarks/tyre/mfeval_reference.m on the .tir files that ship with it
compared: Pure lateral force Fy (kappa 0, no turn slip, 16.7 m/s, nominal pressure), slip angle -15 to 15 deg, load 0.5 to 1.5 FNOMIN, camber 0, -2, -4 deg. KinematiK's PacejkaLateral is built from the same .tir's lateral coefficients and scaling factors.
scope: MF5.2 files (FITTYP 6 or 21): every point. MF6.1/6.2 files: camber 0 only, and only if PKY4 = 2 and the pressure terms vanish at nominal pressure, since KinematiK implements MF5.2; otherwise reported but not graded.
sign: MFeval reports forces in ISO-W axes. If KinematiK's Fy is the opposite sign for the same slip angle, the comparison uses -Fy and says so; any other mismatch is a failure.
correction_2026-11-25: reference_tool said MFeval is validated by its author against TNO MF-Tyre. Its File Exchange page (version 4.3.1) does not say that; it says only that it evaluates MF 5.2, 6.1 and 6.2 models from .tir files. The limits and scope are unchanged.
